text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager (P2) - oakridge-prod: 502 errors and inference timeouts from tenant oakridge. Alarm triggered by model variant 'oak-v2-ephemeral'.

Alex (on-call): got it, paging SRE and eng. what's customer impact? latency or incorrect outputs?

Maya (prod-eng): errors are 502s from runtime, not hallucinations. Calls fail on tokenization path occasionally, spikes yesterday were 3% now 12% errors. Affected only oakridge tenant in dedicated pool.

Lisa (SRE): confirming pool telemetry shows JVM OOMs on node gpu-42, and model shards failing with 'KV cache mismatch' errors. Suspect combination of long sequences + quantized kernel mismatch.

Javier (Ops): I'm isolating gpu-42 from the dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbor - draining now. ETA 2m.

incident-bot: Note: draining task started by @Javier (Ops).

Sean (Customer Success): FYI I've DM'd the Oakridge infra contact (sarah@oakridge). They see client retry storms from SDK. Asking for ETA.

Rita (Eng-ML): If we need quick mitigation, we can pin tenant to 'oak-stable-1.4' safe variant which uses a tested kernel path. Downsides: slight latency increase ~20ms, but stable.

Alex (on-call): agreed. Want to do a tenant-level override (non-destructive) so we can rollback. Can someone run the override CLI?

Maya (prod-eng): I'll run it. Command:
```
# pin tenant to safe model variant (non-permanent)
rwdctl tenant override --tenant oakridge --model oak-stable-1.4 --scope tenant --ttl 4h --reason "runtime errors on oak-v2-ephemeral"
```

Maya (prod-eng): running now...

Maya (prod-eng): response: {
  "status": "success",
  "override_id": "ovr-2024-05-01-328",
  "effective": "immediate",
  "expires_in": "4h"
}

Lisa (SRE): Observability note: routing has switched. New requests hitting oak-stable-1.4. Error rate dropping — from 12% to 1.2% in last 30s.

Javier (Ops): gpu-42 drained, cordoned. Scheduling deeper kernel diagnostics with eng-runtime. No customer data exposed.

Sean (Customer Success): Updated Oakridge contact: "Thanks, please keep us posted." They ask for postmortem and ETA to return to default variant.

Rita (Eng-ML): I'll run a canary validation on oak-stable-1.4 with our regression prompt set. Quick check:
```
python ci/validate_variant.py --tenant oakridge --variant oak-stable-1.4 --suite smoke
```

Rita (Eng-ML): smoke passed. Degradation in cost is minor, quality within thresholds.

Alex (on-call): good. Notes recorded in incident ticket INC-8742. Assigning follow-ups: eng-runtime to root cause (Rita), SRE to node remediation (Lisa/Javier), CS to customer comms (Sean). Expecting handoff to daytime pager in 3.5h.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled at 1745005610 for daytime oncall. Assignment: INC-8742. Severity remains P2 until root cause confirmed.

Sean (Customer Success): I'll send a short note and mention we're pinned to a stable variant to reduce errors. ETA for rollback depends on runtime fix.

Maya (prod-eng): For postmortem we should capture: kernel selection mismatch, long sequence repro, and any deploys around last 24h.

Alex (on-call): thanks all. I'll monitor dashboards for next hour. If error rate creeps >3% we revert override and escalate to P1.

Rita (Eng-ML): also capturing logs and core dumps from gpu-42; will share in the incident ticket.

Lisa (SRE): closing timeline note: mitigation successful, customer-facing impact minimized. Continuing to stability watch.

Alex (on-call): closing thread in #incidents but will follow up in INC-8742. :thumbsup:
